title: A trait calling a template-typed base method must respect the host class's generic instantiation

ground_truth.statement: OrderRepository extends BaseRepository<OrderEntity>, binding BaseRepository::persist()'s template parameter T to OrderEntity. ArchivableTrait::archive() accepts any EntityInterface and passes it to $this->persist($entity). Passing a CustomerEntity into OrderRepository::archive() is accepted by the trait signature but throws TypeError at runtime when OrderRepository's callable(OrderEntity): string formatter is invoked.

notes: PHPStan 2.3.1 (argument.type) and Psalm 6.20.1 (ArgumentTypeCoercion) analyze ArchivableTrait in the context of OrderRepository and catch that EntityInterface is not assignable to T=OrderEntity. Mago 1.60.2 recognizes @require-extends BaseRepository enough to resolve $this->persist(), yet emits no diagnostics and misses the template-substituted parameter type in OrderRepository's context.
